events.title: Sentient Film Screening with Animal Advocacy at UW
events.description:
Come watch the screening for the powerful documentary Sentient, which explores animal experimentation, ahead of its release along with a Q&A with Dr. Lisa Jones-Engel!
When/where: HUB 334 on November 16th from 6:30-8:30 PM, Doors open 6:15 PM.
Everyone is welcome, regardless of diet, lifestyle, or familiarity with animal rights! Free vegan pizza and snacks will be provided.
Free admission, please RSVP!

events.title: Buildspace C6 Demo Day
events.description:
🚀 cseed buildspace demo day is here!!! 🚀
For the past 5 weeks, cseed buildspace cohort 6 members have been working hard on their passion projects for up to 2 hours per week! Now is the time to show off what they've built!
Join us with celebrating the incredible work and dedication of projects with a mix of hardware, design, creator, and software project!
Come out to support our builders, get inspired, and learn about cseed. See you there!
P.S. Dinner, snacks, and drinks will be provided!

[If you need an accommodation or have any questions or concerns, email us at questions@cseed.co]

events.title: BuildHer Expo
events.description:
cseed buildHER is hosting our last event of fall quarter - buildHER fall EXPO!!!
Come join us to explore Arduino, 3D modeling, Figma and more surrounded by a community of builders in a welcoming and inquisitive environment.
The expo will feature hands-on booths where you can dive into exploring these technologies, and leave having learned something new.
We hope to see you there!
